title.zh: 将巴拉望省 罗哈斯市镇 San Vicente村移交给Same省 普林塞萨港市镇的法案
title.en: An Act Transferring the Barrio of San Vicente in the Municipality of Roxas, Province of Palawan, to the Municipality of Puerto Princesa, Same Province
title.orig: An Act Transferring the Barrio of San Vicente in the Municipality of Roxas, Province of Palawan, to the Municipality of Puerto Princesa, Same Province

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2872_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The barrio of San Vicente in the Municipality of Roxas, Province of Palawan, is separated from said municipality, and is transferred to and made part of the Municipality of Puerto Princesa, same province.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1960.
